S, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY)

1. Learned counsel for the petitioner after arguing the matter for some time, submits that, the petition may be dismissed as not pressed at this stage, with liberty to the petitioner to renew his bail application after the alleged eyewitnesses C.W.9 to C.W.11 are examined before the trial Court.
2. His submission is placed on record.
3. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioner, as prayed for.
It is needless to state that, the prosecution and the trial Court shall make all endeavors to examine C.W.9 to C.W.11 before the trial Court on priority.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE SVH CT:PK Pradeep vs The State Of Karnataka on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142754964/
